authority: User-defined architecture, supersedes inconsistent assistant-created labels and stage interpretations

Bronze.definition: The complete source-original raw data downloaded from the six official Taiwan sources, with FinMind as compatible missing-data fallback where appropriate.
Bronze.required: Preserve source-native bytes, source metadata, source date and SHA/CRC; record known gaps. Do not treat a Parquet copy of a native JSON cell as Silver.
Bronze.ready_for_next_stage: Raw data needed by the target dataset has been acquired and integrity/coverage measured according to user-approved source rules.

Silver.definition: FORMAL standardized dataset produced from Bronze via correct parsing and column mapping; standard types, source observation dates, stock/instrument identifiers, market, units, signs and provenance; directly usable by Gold with no further data-format conversion.
Silver.required: Complete canonical field mapping and source-aware date/unit conversion, valid keys and content checks; accept per approved active dataset at >=98% download coverage and >=98% content correctness with critical anomalies isolated.
Silver.ready_for_next_stage: Gold indicator implementation can read the formal Silver schema directly.
Silver.no_extra_stages: Do not define candidate Silver as a separate layer; intermediate tests or incomplete files are unfinished processing outputs, not formal Silver.

Gold.definition: Actual persisted computed JARVIS 400+ analysis indicators and relevant snapshots calculated from formal Silver and directly queryable by ChatGPT for analysis.
Gold.required: Store computed indicator values with formula/version, parameters, required lookback, dataset sources, observation date, available_asof or PIT eligibility and QA state; no missing dependency fabricated.
Gold.no_extra_stages: Do not define descriptive Gold, candidate Gold or preliminary Gold as new data layers. Products lacking required historical source/PIT do not qualify as completed corresponding historical analysis indicators.
Gold.ready_for_use: Named indicator exists as computed, validated records, ready for ChatGPT query for its allowed as-of purpose.

release_policy.unit: per approved dataset market and reporting period, not pooled across unrelated source types
release_policy.critical_failures: Source corruption, invalid identity/date/unit and known lookahead errors must be quarantined and not silently accepted as the 2% tolerance.
release_policy.partial_data_policy: Unavailable or unsupported input fields or indicators remain disabled without blocking independent formally accepted Silver datasets or other Gold indicators.
release_policy.pit: PIT is a validation rule for historical use, not a new layer. Historical Gold analysis must not use source values published after its simulated decision time.
release_policy.missing_history: Long lookback indicators disabled until required earlier Silver history available. They are not replaced by insufficient September-only observations.

operational_workflow: Bronze: acquire and preserve source-original complete downloadable corpus; document gaps.
Silver: perform all original->canonical conversions and QA in same processing operation; publish formally accepted dataset with stable schema.
Gold: compute each approved 400+ indicator from formally accepted Silver and preserve queryable outputs.
Report only Bronze complete, Silver formalized, Gold indicators computed and their source/date coverage; no alternate stage naming.

historical_202609_status.Bronze: Known originals migrated and integrity checked; full source-wide universe not independently certified.
historical_202609_status.Silver: Prior September Parquet files include incomplete source-native JSON serialization and typed subsets; cannot label the full September dataset formalized yet.
historical_202609_status.Gold: Previously generated descriptive snapshots do not establish completion of the full 400+ defined indicator computation or PIT-approved historical backtests.
historical_202609_status.need: Complete and validate the missing formal Silver mappings first, then compute matching Gold indicator groups; avoid repeated Bronze re-download and invalid all-complete claims.

legacy_terminology.CANDIDATE_SILVER: Incomplete Silver conversion output, not a separate layer or a final Silver release
legacy_terminology.DESCRIPTIVE_GOLD: Limited analysis artifact or indicator with restricted historical eligibility; not an extra architecture layer and not a substitute for JARVIS full formal Gold indicator set
legacy_terminology.RAW_JSON_IN_PARQUET: Still needs canonical Silver field conversion
legacy_terminology.PARQUET_EXISTS: Not sufficient evidence of completed Silver
legacy_terminology.WORKFLOW_SUCCESS: Not sufficient evidence of finished Silver or complete Gold
